meta.title: About Amiya_desi | Independent Developer and Creator
meta.description: Meet Amiya_desi, an independent developer focused on Godot games who also builds websites and tools, with projects, practice notes, selected results, and public links

letter.title: Hi, I’m Amiya_desi
letter.intro: I’m Amiya_desi, an independent developer and student focused on indie games; I use Godot to explore time mechanics, multi-window interaction, and narrative experiences; I also build websites and tools and share what I learn

sections.heading: Creative practice
paragraphs: Indie game development: mainly Godot and GDScript, with C# project experience; small games, Game Jams, and longer projects are my way to practice mechanics, implementation, and iteration
Websites and tools: personal sites, GeoScore, and browser tools that turn real problems into things people can use and share
Self-hosting: Docker, VPS, and Cloudflare for deploying and maintaining personal services, with the configuration lessons kept public
Content and workflows: articles, videos, resources, and n8n-assisted organization and distribution so more time can stay with making and talking

sections.heading: Projects and milestones
sections.intro: These projects show different stages of my practice, with current status kept on each project page

items.text: DelayTrace: a Godot game about time delay, recorded actions, and replay, one of my more satisfying recent Jam results with a playable public build
TimeRewindLinker: a puzzle experiment built around rewinding time, replayed actions, and links between a player and echoes of the past
WakeUpAtTheBorder: a Godot game mixing puzzles, dialogue, and combat, awarded second prize in the third GodotHub themed Jam track
Mio’s Window Wanderer: a multi-window narrative prototype I helped make, exploring window navigation and dialogue
GeoScore: a public-web SEO / GEO audit tool that turns page evidence into checks and improvement suggestions
Enhanced Save System: a modular Godot save plugin with GDScript and C# implementations

sections.heading: Current direction
paragraphs: My main goal is to complete and publish my first Steam game

I want to bring lessons from small experiments into a more complete work while continuing to practice implementation, debugging, and judgement; websites, tools, and public notes will keep following real interests and projects

sections.heading: Find me and stay in touch
paragraphs: My usual creator name is Amiya_desi, and my GitHub account is Amiyadesi

items.text: Blog: tutorials, development notes, learning notes, and retrospectives
GitHub: public code and open-source projects
itch.io: small games, Jam work, and gameplay experiments
Bilibili: videos, games, and tinkering notes
Guestbook: suggestions, questions, or a simple hello
Support: help keep development and maintenance going

signature.ps: P.S. If anything in this letter resonates, feel free to leave a small note on the guestbook

items.question: What is sayori.org
items.answer: It is the personal site of independent developer Amiya_desi, presenting Godot games, websites and tools, open-source projects, writing, and public links

items.question: What does the blog cover
items.answer: blog.sayori.org records Godot development, websites and self-hosting, AI workflows, tools and resources, project retrospectives, and creative learning

items.question: What is your current main goal
items.answer: My main goal is to complete and publish my first Steam game; other experiments, web tools, and articles will continue with real project and learning progress

items.question: How can I contact you or learn more
items.answer: Use me@sayori.org, or continue to GitHub, the blog, itch.io, Bilibili, and the guestbook
